title: Haq Ka Irfan
body:
Haq Ka Irfan
haq ka irfaan jo paaya to ali yaad aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
dil me quraan samaaya to ali yaad aaya
aadam o nuh payambar ho ya hazrat isa
<<DIVIDER>>
yunus o khizr ho ilyaas ya hazrat musa
waqt in par bhi jo aaya to ali yaad aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar tha allah ka maujud makin koyi na tha
koyi aayega yahaan ye bhi yaqeen koyi na tha
<<DIVIDER>>
dar jo diwaar me aaya to ali yaad aaya
senkaro sur mathe aur pahelwaan hazaar
<<DIVIDER>>
jo the khaibar me sabhi yaar magar mere yaar
mard ka zikr jab aaya to ali yaad aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
jism ek ek se do tukre baraabar dekhe
khun ki barsaat huwi urhte huwe sar dekhe
<<DIVIDER>>
ran me abbas jab aaya to ali yaad
neza o tir o tabar kya koyi khanjar na mila
<<DIVIDER>>
laakh dhundha kahi kuffar ka lashkar na mila
saaf maidaan nazar aaya to ali aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
apna kuch hosh na tha itni pareshaani thi
ghame dunya ne mujhe gher liya tha phir bhi
<<DIVIDER>>
haath momin se milaaya to ali yaad aaya
yun to mein rat ta raha saare sawaal aur jawaab
<<DIVIDER>>
par naqirein ne turbat me mujhe behre hisaab
aa ke jis waqt jagaaya to ali yaad aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
zikr nabiyon ka suna khub ya ke baare digar
mein nuseri to nahi kheir se wallah magar
<<DIVIDER>>
zikr allah ka aaya to ali yaad aaya
jo ke aqwaale payambar ko bhulaa bethe the
<<DIVIDER>>
ham ali ko bhi nahi jaante jo kehte the
un ko miti me dabaaya to ali yaad aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
qalbe baatil ko kayi tukron me bat te dekha
takht kya chiz hai darbaar ulat te dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
khutba zainab ne sunaaya to ali yaad aaya
shabe meraaj ajab baat huwi ya gohar
<<DIVIDER>>
sun ke aawaaze khuda chonk uthe payghamabar
jab nazar kuch nahi aaya to ali yaad aaya
author: Mir Hassan Mir
